subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a religious festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhi Jayanti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gandhi Jayanti is observed on **2nd October** each year to mark the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**, the leader of the Indian independence movement.
 
• It is a **national holiday** in India and is celebrated with various activities, including prayer services, commemorative ceremonies, and cultural events.
 
• Unlike other options listed, Gandhi Jayanti is not associated with any religious practices or rituals; it is a secular celebration.
 
• The day is also observed as the **International Day of Non-Violence** by the United Nations to honor Gandhi's philosophy of non-violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Purab**

 
 
• Guru Purab, also known as Gurpurab, is a festival that celebrates the birth anniversaries of the Sikh Gurus.
 
• The most significant Guru Purab is the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism.
 
• It involves religious ceremonies, prayers, and community service.
 
 
 
• **Good Friday**
 
 
• Good Friday is a Christian religious holiday commemorating the crucifixion of Jesus Christ and his death at Calvary.
 
• It is observed during Holy Week as part of the Paschal Triduum on the Friday preceding Easter Sunday.
 
• The day is marked by church services, prayers, and fasting.
 
 
 
• **Muharram**
 
 
• Muharram is the first month of the Islamic calendar and is one of the four sacred months of the year.
 
• The day of Ashura, which falls on the 10th of Muharram, is of particular significance to Muslims.
 
• It is a day of mourning for Shia Muslims, who commemorate the martyrdom of Imam Hussain, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad, at the Battle of Karbala.
